priorityList: Cast Shadow Dance when you have 6 or more combo points and Secret Technique is ready or Shadow Blades is active.
Do not cast Shadow Dance when Shadow Blades has less than 10 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Shadow Blades during Shadow Dance.
Cast Secret Technique during Shadow Dance with 6 or more combo points.
Cast Coup de Grace with 6 or more combo points.
Cast Eviscerate with 6 or more combo points.
Cast Vanish at any point when Shadow Dance is not active, followed immediately by Shadowstrike.
Cast Shadowstrike whenever available to build combo points.
Cast Goremaw's Bite (if talented) or Backstab to build combo points.
Cast Symbols of Death on cooldown, ideally aligned with Shadow Dance charges.
Cast Shadow Dance while Symbols of Death is active.
Cast Cold Blood immediately before using Secret Technique.
Cast Secret Technique during Shadow Dance and Symbols of Death windows when at 5 or more Combo Points.
Maintain Rupture with 5 or more Combo Points, refreshing when there are fewer than 7 seconds remaining.
Cast Eviscerate at 5 or more Combo Points to spend resources and trigger Coupe de Grace.
Use Thistle Tea if you are low on Energy or need to refresh the Mastery buff from the talent.
Use Shadowstrike to generate Combo Points while in Shadow Dance or Stealth.
Use Backstab to generate Combo Points when Shadow Dance and Stealth are unavailable.
